description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of percentages across different values of "Pass@1," which is plotted along the horizontal axis ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 in increments of 0.2. The vertical axis, labeled "Percentage," uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.1. The chart displays five individual bars, each corresponding to a specific Pass@1 value: the bar at 0.0 is labeled "11.2%" and is light blue; the bar at 0.2 is labeled "3.4%" and is light blue; the bar at 0.4 is also labeled "3.4%" and is light blue; the bar at 0.6 is labeled "5.8%" and is light blue; and the bar at 1.0 is labeled "76.2%" and is light blue. A red dashed vertical line is drawn at the 0.8 mark on the horizontal axis, and an annotation in red text above this line indicates "mean: 0.82." The bars are not sorted and are presented in ascending order of their Pass@1 value from left to right. There is no legend or additional visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any of the bars.
